name: Quick Response and Community Grants (Regenerative Environment)
summary: Auckland and Northland community funder whose Regenerative Environment focus area backs conservation and restoration of the environment, with priority for projects led by tangata whenua. Quick Response grants go up to NZD 25,000 and Community Grants cover larger requests.

eligibility.rule: Strongly fit with one of the funder's four focus areas
Generate no private or individual gain
Keep project revenue within its reasonable costs
No Foundation North grant received in the last 12 months
Have no more than one funding request under consideration at a time

documents: Letter of support, if first-time applicant or no grant in last five years
Compiled, reviewed or audited accounts, if required by the governing document
Preferred quote for each funded item
Heritage New Zealand support letter, if the request is for a heritage project

status.quote: We have two funding pathways that are open all year, and that you can apply for online at any time

applicant_types.quote: Our funding is for not-for-profit groups and impact-led organisations doing charitable work

geography.quote: Does your service, project or programme benefit Auckland and/or Northland communities?

access.quote: We have two funding pathways that are open all year, and that you can apply for online at any time

effort.quote: Log in to the Funding Hub, complete your organisation profile and begin your application.
Once you submit, our team will review your application for completeness.
Once your application is complete, it joins other requests to be carefully reviewed by our assessment team.

eligibility.quote: Does your service, project or programme strongly fit with one of our four focus areas?
Does your group or organisation have charitable purpose?
Our funding is for not-for-profit groups and impact-led organisations doing charitable work (where no private or individual gain is generated).
Does your service, project or programme benefit Auckland and/or Northland communities?

If your project is likely to generate revenue over and above what would reasonably cover the costs of the project, it is unlikely to be a strong fit with Foundation North's status as a Community Trust and as such it will be ineligible.
Organisations are eligible to receive a grant once every 12 months.
No, we will only consider one request for funding from an organisation at a time.

after_award.quote: All organisations that receive funding from Foundation North are required to complete an Impact Report when the grant has been spent or the project/initiative is complete.

documents.quote: recent signed annual accounts, a detailed budget

a letter of support from Heritage New Zealand is required if your funding request is for a heritage project, including building restoration. Documents to submit How many letters of support do I need? If you are a first-time applicant, or you haven't received a grant from Foundation North in the last five years, please provide us with a letter of support.

If your organisation's governing document states that you must have compiled, reviewed or audited accounts, then you must provide them with your funding request. Documents to submit How many quotes do I need to provide for items I want funding to purchase? One quote (your preferred quote) must be provided for each item/s you want to be funded.
